description: This file implements cache management functions for a LZMA compressed kernel loader, specifically handling cache flushing for MIPS architecture on Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX based boards. It includes routines for cache line operations and references external cache operation headers.

methods.name: void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Flushes a specified memory region from the cache by performing cache line writeback and invalidate operations across the range.

ctags.name: flush_cache
ctags.pattern: /^void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr, unsigned long size)$/
